notes.title: First Steam Release 0.3.1 and Version 0.3.1a HOTFIX
notes.content:
[u][b]Averon Rising Development Build 0.3.1 [Steam Deployment][/b][/u]

[b]Features:[/b]
[list] 
[*] Pilot Training(Paid)
[*] Pilot Healing(Paid)
[*] Pilot Healing(Unpaid incremental)
[*] Daily login bonus
[*] Comstar Credit Display
[*] Comstar Credit Cash in system
[*] Add multiple purchasable mechs
[*] Pilot ejection death
[*] Pilot persistent health
[*] Pilot combat experience
[*] Pilot Leveling
[*] Pilot assignment system
[*] Pilot Recruitment
[/list]

[b]Behind the scene features:[/b]
[list]
[*] Empire assignment to player
[*] Map tile database systems
[*] Changed Imperial data from credentials system to Empire database
[/list]

[u][b]Averon Rising Version 0.3.1a HOTFIX[/b][/u]

[b]Bug:[/b]
[list]
[*] Free play match still expected players to have 25000 imperial to select a mech.
[/list]

To view all other patch notes go to:
http://www.averongame.com/forum/
